title: Visit to Allen Dulles's former office in Switzerland
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Visit to Allen Dulles's former office in Switzerland, about WWII era; visit years later at Switzerland, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He told us when he got permission to maintain a very active office here that as long as he was in Switzerland, no American law could reach him

plain: Harald Malmgren, an economist who advised several US presidents, tells of visiting the old office in Switzerland once used by Allen Dulles, the American spy chief who worked there during the Second World War and later ran the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. Malmgren says Swiss officials told his group that Dulles, when he got permission to run his office there, said that as long as he was in Switzerland no American law could reach him. The story suggests Dulles saw himself as working beyond the reach of his own government.
